result.reason: The redline appropriately creates a 30-day non-renewal window for automatic 12-month renewals, satisfying the fallback notice requirement. However, it does not include the fallback requirement that renewal price increases be capped at 5% or less. It also does not reach the preferred position because it omits the 60-day Vendor reminder and the lesser-of-CPI-and-3% price cap. The insertion is narrow and generally preserves the remaining termination framework, although the separate 90-day post-Initial-Term termination right remains potentially confusing alongside the new non-renewal mechanism.
